ai_detector.info_text:
The AI Content Detector helps identify AI-generated content in student submissions.

Features:
• Detection of AI-generated text
• Multi-model analysis
• Confidence scoring
• Detailed reporting
• Batch processing support
• Multiple file format support (TXT, DOCX, PDF)
• Historical analysis tracking
• Comparison with known AI patterns

Detection Capabilities:
✓ GPT-based content detection
✓ Statistical analysis
✓ Pattern recognition
✓ Writing style analysis
✓ Linguistic markers
✓ Coherence patterns
✓ Vocabulary analysis
✓ Sentence structure analysis

The full AI Detector interface provides:
→ Advanced detection algorithms
→ Detailed analysis reports
→ Visual confidence indicators
→ Submission history
→ Export capabilities
→ Bulk processing

Click the 'Launch Full AI Detector' button above to access the complete detection system.
